dialogueInline.speaker: Beatrice Halstead
dialogueInline.text: One night. Everything guests loved this year.

dialogueInline.speaker: Fleur Fontaine
dialogueInline.text: It photographs beautifully from the entrance.

dialogueInline.speaker: Nia Patel
dialogueInline.text: Nobody will stand at the entrance for the whole party.

dialogueInline.speaker: Maya Serrano
dialogueInline.text: Where did the reef go?

dialogueInline.speaker: Beatrice Halstead
dialogueInline.text: The sponsor wall. Of course.

dialogueSource: Azure Reach Issue 6 editorial C: panel balloon order and voice pass

dialogueInline.speaker: Salvatore “Sal” Delgado
dialogueInline.text: My cart can't get through.

dialogueInline.speaker: Fleur Fontaine
dialogueInline.text: Take the left.

dialogueInline.speaker: Salvatore “Sal” Delgado
dialogueInline.text: Raf's on the left. With enough food for a ship.

dialogueInline.speaker: Maya Serrano
dialogueInline.text: We're all fighting for the same six feet.

dialogueInline.speaker: Fleur Fontaine
dialogueInline.text: I can lose the wall.

dialogueInline.speaker: Beatrice Halstead
dialogueInline.text: Let me walk the whole gala first. Then we'll decide.

dialogueSource: Azure Reach Issue 6 editorial C: panel balloon order and voice pass

dialogueInline.speaker: Julian Heatherington
dialogueInline.text: That's my shot.

dialogueInline.speaker: Fleur Fontaine
dialogueInline.text: That's my light.

dialogueInline.speaker: Nia Patel
dialogueInline.text: That's the way people get to the water.

dialogueInline.speaker: Julian Heatherington
dialogueInline.text: Your projection could go higher.

dialogueInline.speaker: Fleur Fontaine
dialogueInline.text: And your face could go somewhere else.

dialogueInline.speaker: Beatrice Halstead
dialogueInline.text: You both made this look wonderful on paper.

dialogueInline.speaker: Nia Patel
dialogueInline.text: A stroller can't get through either setup.

dialogueInline.speaker: Beatrice Halstead
dialogueInline.text: Fine. Show me the room without either of you in front of it.

dialogueSource: Azure Reach Issue 6 editorial C: panel balloon order and voice pass

dialogueInline.speaker: Elliot
dialogueInline.text: We promised the sponsor recognition, the awards and accessible hospitality.

dialogueInline.speaker: Beatrice
dialogueInline.text: Only those three?

dialogueInline.speaker: Elliot
dialogueInline.text: Everything else is in our own presentation.

dialogueInline.speaker: Fleur
dialogueInline.text: Even the huge photo wall?

dialogueInline.speaker: Elliot
dialogueInline.text: Especially the huge photo wall.

dialogueInline.speaker: Julian
dialogueInline.text: My opening speech?

dialogueInline.speaker: Elliot
dialogueInline.text: I am afraid that is also entirely voluntary.

dialogueInline.speaker: Beatrice
dialogueInline.text: I may enjoy this more than I expected.

dialogueSource: Azure Reach Issue 6 editorial C: panel balloon order and voice pass

dialogueInline.speaker: Julian Heatherington
dialogueInline.text: Three extra live hits are gone.

dialogueInline.speaker: Maya Serrano
dialogueInline.text: You crossed them out yourself?

dialogueInline.speaker: Julian Heatherington
dialogueInline.text: By the third habitat it's going to look like the same room with different fish.

dialogueInline.speaker: Kyler Chen
dialogueInline.text: You've still got one live moment.

dialogueInline.speaker: Julian Heatherington
dialogueInline.text: I can make one worth watching.

dialogueInline.speaker: Beatrice Halstead
dialogueInline.text: Then keep the one.

dialogueSource: Azure Reach Issue 6 editorial C: panel balloon order and voice pass

dialogueInline.speaker: Salvatore “Sal” Delgado
dialogueInline.text: Six feet left?

dialogueInline.speaker: Fleur Fontaine
dialogueInline.text: You remember the turtle presentation.

dialogueInline.speaker: Salvatore “Sal” Delgado
dialogueInline.text: Remember the cart it blocked.

dialogueInline.speaker: Fleur Fontaine
dialogueInline.text: I have hated this wall all afternoon.

dialogueInline.speaker: Sponsor Representative
dialogueInline.text: It was in the approved rendering.

dialogueInline.speaker: Fleur Fontaine
dialogueInline.text: The logo stays. The wall has overstayed its welcome.

dialogueSource: Azure Reach Issue 6 editorial C: panel balloon order and voice pass

dialogueInline.speaker: Nia Patel
dialogueInline.text: You're our very important guest. Find the ray gallery.

dialogueInline.speaker: Beatrice Halstead
dialogueInline.text: I can see it. Why can't I get there?

dialogueInline.speaker: Pip O'Mally
dialogueInline.text: Good evening. The view's right this way.

dialogueInline.speaker: Nia Patel
dialogueInline.text: Pip didn't take the special route.

dialogueInline.speaker: Beatrice Halstead
dialogueInline.text: I hate this route.

dialogueInline.speaker: Pip O'Mally
dialogueInline.text: You'll love the rays.

dialogueInline.speaker: Fleur Fontaine
dialogueInline.text: I'll take out the divider.

dialogueSource: Azure Reach Issue 6 editorial C: panel balloon order and voice pass

dialogueInline.speaker: Raf
dialogueInline.text: If everybody sits through dinner, nobody gets to see the water.

dialogueInline.speaker: Beatrice
dialogueInline.text: People do enjoy a formal dinner.

dialogueInline.speaker: Raf
dialogueInline.text: Then let them sit. And let them get up.

dialogueInline.speaker: Nia
dialogueInline.text: There's room for seating around the edge.

dialogueInline.speaker: Pip
dialogueInline.text: And a lot of room to enjoy the view.

dialogueInline.speaker: Beatrice
dialogueInline.text: Are we still calling this a gala?

dialogueInline.speaker: Raf
dialogueInline.text: With these prices? Absolutely.

dialogueSource: Azure Reach Issue 6 editorial C: panel balloon order and voice pass

dialogueInline.speaker: Dora
dialogueInline.text: The animals aren't part of the decorations.

dialogueInline.speaker: Beatrice
dialogueInline.text: Our donors were promised something special.

dialogueInline.speaker: Julian
dialogueInline.text: Then bring them to this window and let them look. Really look.

dialogueInline.speaker: Pip
dialogueInline.text: They'll want to stay.

dialogueInline.speaker: Dora
dialogueInline.text: There's plenty to see if they do.

dialogueInline.speaker: Beatrice
dialogueInline.text: I'll take this room over a photo backdrop.

dialogueSource: Azure Reach Issue 6 editorial C: panel balloon order and voice pass

dialogueInline.speaker: Salvatore “Sal” Delgado
dialogueInline.text: There's the ray gallery. I thought we'd lost it.

dialogueInline.speaker: Fleur Fontaine
dialogueInline.text: It was always there. My wall was just in its way.

dialogueInline.speaker: Nia Patel
dialogueInline.text: Guests will find it again.

dialogueInline.speaker: Maya Serrano
dialogueInline.text: I might come look at it when I'm not moving equipment.

dialogueSource: Azure Reach Issue 6 editorial C: panel balloon order and voice pass

dialogueInline.speaker: Pip O'Mally
dialogueInline.text: Next stop.

dialogueInline.speaker: Staffer
dialogueInline.text: Wait.

dialogueInline.speaker: Julian Heatherington
dialogueInline.text: We're thirty seconds down.

dialogueInline.speaker: Staffer
dialogueInline.text: I'm supposed to be a guest.

dialogueInline.speaker: Pip O'Mally
dialogueInline.text: Very committed.

dialogueInline.speaker: Beatrice Halstead
dialogueInline.text: Keep moving.

dialogueSource: Azure Reach Issue 6 editorial C: panel balloon order and voice pass

dialogueInline.speaker: Julian Heatherington
dialogueInline.text: Look at that reef—

dialogueInline.speaker: Kyler Chen
dialogueInline.text: Award cue.

dialogueInline.speaker: Staffer
dialogueInline.text: Can't we stay for a minute?

dialogueInline.speaker: Beatrice Halstead
dialogueInline.text: We can. Those fish aren't waiting for us.

dialogueSource: Azure Reach Issue 6 editorial C: panel balloon order and voice pass

dialogueInline.speaker: Beatrice Halstead
dialogueInline.text: Pen.

dialogueInline.speaker: Julian Heatherington
dialogueInline.text: I was hoping you'd use the other end.

dialogueInline.speaker: Fleur Fontaine
dialogueInline.text: There goes my photo stop.

dialogueInline.speaker: Beatrice Halstead
dialogueInline.text: And the second live hit.

dialogueInline.speaker: Nia Patel
dialogueInline.text: What goes there now?

dialogueInline.speaker: Beatrice Halstead
dialogueInline.text: The reef.

dialogueSource: Azure Reach Issue 6 editorial C: panel balloon order and voice pass

dialogueInline.speaker: Staff Educator
dialogueInline.text: What do you notice first?

dialogueInline.speaker: Julian Heatherington
dialogueInline.text: I—

dialogueInline.speaker: Fleur Fontaine
dialogueInline.text: Julian?

dialogueInline.speaker: Julian Heatherington
dialogueInline.text: Just... wait.

dialogueSource: Azure Reach Issue 6 editorial C: panel balloon order and voice pass

dialogueInline.speaker: Guest 1
dialogueInline.text: Which dolphin picked this souvenir?

dialogueInline.speaker: Pip O'Mally
dialogueInline.text: Carlos in retail.

dialogueInline.speaker: Julian Heatherington
dialogueInline.text: We might see the rays at eight-forty. That's their usual feeding window.

dialogueSource: Azure Reach Issue 6 editorial C: panel balloon order and voice pass

dialogueInline.speaker: Sponsor Representative
dialogueInline.text: Oh.

dialogueInline.speaker: Pip O'Mally
dialogueInline.text: Welcome to Azure Reach.

dialogueInline.speaker: Nia Patel
dialogueInline.text: Beatrice?

dialogueInline.speaker: Beatrice Halstead
dialogueInline.text: Leave it.

dialogueSource: Azure Reach Issue 6 editorial C: panel balloon order and voice pass

dialogueInline.speaker: VIP Guest
dialogueInline.text: Could you make them do one more pass for the board?

dialogueInline.speaker: Julian Heatherington
dialogueInline.text: No. Dora can tell you what she's been watching along the far wall.

dialogueInline.speaker: VIP Guest
dialogueInline.text: I will come see.

dialogueInline.speaker: Dr. Dorothea “Dora” Kwon
dialogueInline.text: Come over here. You will see it better.

dialogueInline.speaker: Beatrice Halstead
dialogueInline.text: Award in six.

dialogueSource: Azure Reach Issue 6 editorial C: panel balloon order and voice pass

dialogueInline.speaker: Kyler Chen
dialogueInline.text: Main display's gone dark.

dialogueInline.speaker: Julian Heatherington
dialogueInline.text: Awards in twenty seconds.

dialogueInline.speaker: Fleur Fontaine
dialogueInline.text: Use the approved Conservation Wall feed.

dialogueInline.speaker: Kyler Chen
dialogueInline.text: I have it.

dialogueInline.speaker: Pip O'Mally
dialogueInline.text: Guests are still watching the reef.

dialogueInline.speaker: Kyler Chen
dialogueInline.text: The main image is back.

dialogueInline.text: I missed six minutes of the tour.

dialogueInline.speaker: Beatrice Halstead
dialogueInline.text: Did something go wrong?

dialogueInline.speaker: Sponsor Representative
dialogueInline.text: The jellyfish gallery. I couldn't leave.

dialogueInline.speaker: Julian Heatherington
dialogueInline.text: That room's been keeping people late all week.

dialogueInline.speaker: Maya Serrano
dialogueInline.text: It's a good place to lose track of time.

dialogueInline.speaker: Beatrice Halstead
dialogueInline.text: Before we—

dialogueInline.speaker: Beatrice Halstead
dialogueInline.text: Maya. Sal. Come here.

dialogueInline.speaker: Maya Serrano
dialogueInline.text: Absolutely not.

dialogueInline.text: Too late.

dialogueInline.speaker: Beatrice Halstead
dialogueInline.text: They want to do this monthly.

dialogueInline.speaker: Julian Heatherington
dialogueInline.text: There are worse things to be asked.

dialogueInline.speaker: Fleur Fontaine
dialogueInline.text: There are also better things to sleep through.

dialogueInline.speaker: Beatrice Halstead
dialogueInline.text: I haven't answered.
